entries.title: SKREEM / SKIM — preconditions
entries.description: Confirm battery support, ignition state, and that all existing keys are available before any security session. Document VIN and module IDs for the partner tool.

entries.title: OEM PIN entry (authorized tool only)
entries.description: PIN is required for SKIM access; enter only in licensed OEM or partner software — never in this app. Verify technician authorization and site policy before proceeding.

entries.title: SKIM/SKREEM key learn sequence
entries.description: Follow Stellantis service information for transponder enrollment (FOBIK/proximity as applicable). Multiple keys supported per platform; no automated flash or bypass in CU1.

entries.title: Post-learn verification
entries.description: Confirm start authorization, DTC clearance, and RF hub alignment per OEM checklist. Retain audit log from the authorized tool chain.
